clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth trades the wisdom of Agamaggan for blood shards. The captive quilboar offers Horde spellcasters a ritual drawn from the ancient boar god’s power.

At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth is held prisoner by the Horde. The quilboar trades his people’s magical secrets for blood shards, crimson crystals said to have formed from Agamaggan’s spilled blood. The towering boar Demigod died in the War of the Ancients. Mangletooth says the geomancers and shaman of his tribes use the shards to channel divine power in their rituals.

Other shard offerings bring physical resilience or swiftness. Mangletooth’s Wisdom ritual instead sharpens intellect and arcane ability. For four blood shards, he calls on Agamaggan’s spirit to grant you cunning in your confrontations, then reminds you of your mortality.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, traveler.
If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your enemies should fear you even more, traveler.
Tell Mangletooth tales of your cunning in battle when next we meet—be it in this life, or the next.
